name: Tomboldt the Pallid
backstory: Tomboldt the Pallid is a Lolth-Sworn Drow. He is on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, and can be encountered while following the quest Investigate the Suspicious Toys.
